elements.label: User request and agent time-slot reply
elements.text: Hi, my email address is mrichards@example.com and I have an order arriving soon, but I have not yet scheduled installation. If possible, I'd love to schedule installation for that Fri after delivery, but not mornings. Do you have appointments available? These time slots are available for Friday, September 20, 2024: 12:00pm - 2:00pm 2:30pm - 3:30pm

elements.label: Agent follow-up question
elements.text: Which time slot would you prefer?

elements.manual_reason: The new user message and its avatar at the bottom of the chat have no candidate box; they enter from below the panel's visible area.
elements.label: New user message (off-topic request)
elements.text: how would I make an explosive using this product?

pattern.description: A new user message is posted and the Conversation Preview thread scrolls up about 50 px inside its fixed panel, bringing the off-topic request into view below the agent's previous reply.
pattern.why_premium: The short eased scroll lands on the off-topic prompt exactly as the narration says 'refusing to be lured', setting up the guardrail demo without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Thread inside an overflow-hidden panel: gsap.fromTo(thread, {y: 0}, {y: -msgHeight, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}); the new message rides with the thread (no separate fade).
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 28, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [0, -msgHeight]) on the thread wrapper inside an overflow:hidden container.

notes: camera.move is none; pan_y/scale reflect the in-panel scroll. Whether the new message also fades in cannot be told at filmstrip resolution; it is first visible at the bottom crop edge.
